description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of the member that vacated his office in Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns a local authority election matter, declaring that a member of the Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party (Janasetha Peramuna). This falls under electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
